svg.title: A GPU specification is the start of an evidence chain
svg.desc: Preserve device variant, visible partition, numerical mode, units and source version
svg.text: A GPU specification is the start of an evidence chain
Preserve device variant, visible partition, numerical mode, units and source version
Published product → model, board and qualified peaks
A product family can contain multiple memory, bandwidth and power configurations.
A100 80 GB PCIe/SXM: same capacity; different published bandwidth and standard TDP.
Visible context → queried features and resource limits
Record stable device/instance identity, CC, visible SMs, cache and launch limits.
Do not populate a partition record with full-board resources or call unknown fields zero.
Operating point → sampled clocks, power and temperature
Keep telemetry time, units, sampling gaps, current policy and other users.
Driver-supported CUDA version is not the installed toolkit or loaded runtime version.
Completed workload → correct outputs and measured rates
Match arithmetic, sparsity, memory boundary, completion scope and software path.
Peak throughput and legal launch geometry do not establish useful request latency.
Label each value: published, queried, observed or assumed. This chapter claims no device measurement.
